functional_correctness.description: The solution meets the functional requirements as stated in the prompt, producing the correct output for all specified cases.

edge_case_handling.description: The solution effectively handles edge cases that could arise in the problem, ensuring robustness against unusual inputs or conditions.

efficiency.description: The solution adheres to the required time complexity and is optimized for performance, particularly given constraints on input size.

robustness.description: The solution demonstrates resilience to unexpected inputs or errors, maintaining proper functionality under various conditions.

api_library_usage.description: The solution appropriately uses programming constructs, libraries, or APIs relevant to the task while avoiding unnecessary complexity.

readability_maintainability.description: The code is easy to read and understand, with clear structure and comments, making it maintainable for future development.

error_security_handling.description: The solution includes measures to handle potential errors and security vulnerabilities, thus preventing common pitfalls.
